about_short_description.short_description: Dott is a transportation company that offers shared electrical scooters and bikes.

product.name: Shared Electric Scooter Rides
product.description: A shared electric scooter rental service for short-distance urban travel. Users locate, unlock, ride, and park scooters through the Dott mobile app.

product.name: Shared Electric Bike Rides
product.description: A shared electric bicycle rental service for short-distance urban transportation. Users access and manage bike trips through the Dott mobile app.

product.name: Dott Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for finding, unlocking, paying for, and managing Dott scooter and bike rides. It also provides riding, parking, account, and customer-support functions.

product.name: Shared Micromobility Operations for Cities
product.description: A managed deployment and operating service for shared scooters and bikes in partnership with cities, transport authorities, and public-transport operators.
